title: Microsoft Teams: call history, voicemail and recordings in separate tabs per phone line
summary: The briefing accurately reports the automatic rollout, affected users and published schedule. The administrator path and PowerShell command are documented, and the briefing explicitly reports the differing descriptions of history and voicemail in Microsoft's notice and Learn documentation.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A licence or charge specific to the per-line tabs has not been published.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams multi-line call history tabs licensing price charge Teams Phone; Teams per-line call history license. Read roadmap, MC1484013, Configure Multi-line in Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Teams add-on licenses; no tabs-specific charge or licence found.

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap nor MC1484013 names a licence, meter or price for this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams multi-line call history tabs licensing price charge Teams Phone. Read the supplied roadmap record and MC1484013 in full; neither names a licence, meter or price for the tabs.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Alternate lines have the same licensing requirements as the user's primary phone number.
claims.quote: Alternate lines have the same licensing requirements as the user’s primary phone number.

claims.quote:
| Teams Phone | Direct Routing, Operator Connect, Teams Phone Mobile |
| Teams Phone with Calling Plan | Direct Routing, Operator Connect, Teams Phone Mobile, Calling Plan |

claims.claim: Call forwarding for alternate lines follows the same rules as the primary line.
claims.quote: Call forwarding for alternate lines follows the same rules as primary line.

claims.claim: Forwarding alternate-line calls may result in extra cost depending on licensing.
claims.quote: Depending on licensing, this action may result in extra cost.

claims.claim: The multi-line page describes mobile support for alternate lines as coming soon.

claims.claim: Users can be assigned one primary line and up to nine alternate lines.
claims.quote: Users can be assigned one primary line and up to nine more alternate lines.

claims.claim: A user must have a primary line assigned before an alternate line can be assigned.
claims.quote: Users must have a primary line assigned from their usage location before an alternate line can be assigned.

claims.claim: Users must be voice enabled for alternate lines.
claims.quote: Users must be "voice enabled" for alternate lines.

claims.claim: Multi-line is not supported for users located in India.
claims.quote: User should not be located in India. We currently do not support multi-line in India.

claims.claim: No administrator UI setting or automation command is documented to turn the per-line tabs on or off.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams multi-line call history tabs enable disable policy PowerShell setting; Teams multi-line tabs disable. Read MC1484013 and Learn multi-line; searched Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy reference for multi-line, alternate, tabs and history. No tab visibility control found.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Alternate phone numbers are assigned at Teams admin center > Users > Manage users > user > Account > Assigned phone number > Assign alternate phone number.
claims.quote:
From the Teams admin center, go to Users > Manage users.
Select a user.
From the user's Account tab, under Assigned phone number, select Assign alternate phone number.

claims.claim: The printed Set-CsPhoneNumberAssignment command assigns a Calling Plan number as an alternate line.
claims.quote: Set-CsPhoneNumberAssignment -Identity user1@contoso.com -PhoneNumber '+14255551234' -PhoneNumberType CallingPlan -AssignmentCategory Alternate

claims.claim: Multi-line administration requires Teams Administrator, Teams Communications Administrator or Teams Telephony Administrator.
claims.quote:
Admin role: You must have one of the following roles:
Teams Administrator
Teams Communications Administrator
Teams Telephony Administrator

claims.claim: Teams PowerShell Module version 7.6.0 or later is required for the updated Set-CsPhoneNumberAssignment cmdlets.
claims.quote: You must have Teams PowerShell Module version 7.6.0 or later to use the updated Set-CsPhoneNumberAssignment cmdlets.

claims.claim: Removal of the primary line also removes alternate lines, including through provisioning events such as licence removal.
claims.quote: Removal of primary line also removes all alternate lines from the user. The primary line can be removed from the user by a system provisioning event such as license removal

claims.claim: Users can view and manage activity separately for each phone line.
claims.quote: Users will be able to view and manage activity separately for each phone line.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The notice describes no new data source, data access or sharing introduced by the display redesign.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams multi-line call history tabs recordings voicemail access permissions identity data sources automated actions. Read supplied MC1484013 in full and Configure Multi-line in Microsoft Teams; the notice describes grouping existing call activity, not new data sources or sharing.

claims.claim: No change to sign-in, roles or permissions is described for the tabs.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams multi-line call history tabs recordings voicemail access permissions identity data sources automated actions. Read MC1484013 and Configure Multi-line in Microsoft Teams; no tab-specific change to sign-in, roles or permissions found.

claims.claim: The notice describes no automated actions beyond presenting the reorganised activity to users.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams multi-line call history tabs recordings voicemail access permissions identity data sources automated actions. Read MC1484013 in full; automatic enablement and tab creation are described, but no autonomous call or data-management actions.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions, final bullet
